verdict.rationale: Zapier ships a built-in agent capability: Zapier Agents lets users create specialized agents, with help from the in-product Zapier Copilot, that perform tasks across 9,000+ apps (zapier-docs-8). Zapier also uses in-product AI to generate troubleshooting instructions (zapier-docs-10). The MCP material describes external AI clients calling Zapier, not a built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how delegation to Agents/Copilot works (task scope, autonomy, review/approval), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in assistant performs delegated tasks well.
